svg.title: Inbox prompt flow
svg.desc: The native Inbox composer submits a registered turn to the Embedded companion over a private Unix socket or to the paired Distributed gateway over HTTPS. Shared QA admission checks permissions and captures fresh, scoped readiness, host metrics and Jobs counts for every new accepted turn. Follow-ups can reuse the previous answered topic and take new observations. Specific facts and summaries of failed or unresolved checks use current counts, check names and timestamped evidence. Broad readiness summaries use a durable queue and a sandboxed BERT worker with a 256-token input window. The coordinator verifies cited selections against the snapshot and can use complete fresh readiness observations when a summary returns no usable selection. The backend commits the canonical turn and ordered events. Inbox resumes from a cursor or fetches the latest turn. The mini dial sits under the reply, and Sources reveals the timestamped citations.
